data.one_liner: Flutter package for recording audio with real-time waveform visualization.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WaveformRecorder widget and WaveformRecorderController to record audio while visualizing the waveform in real time. It supports cross-platform audio recording and exposes the resulting recording as an XFile.
use_when: You are building chat applications that require voice messaging features.
You need to show a real-time audio waveform while recording sound.
avoid_when: You only need background audio playback without recording or visual waveforms.
strengths: Cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop
Clean controller-based API with automatic state management
weaknesses: Requires manual platform setup and permissions via the underlying record package
Temporary files on native platforms must be manually cleaned up by your app
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up the underlying record package instructions, including platform-specific permissions like microphone access (e.g., NSMicrophoneUsageDescription on macOS).

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you need raw audio recording capabilities without the built-in waveform UI widget.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if your primary requirement is playing back recorded audio streams or files rather than recording with a waveform.
